findings.finding: CircuitTaskSourcePublicationV1 has private fields and public read-only getters. Its original Source constructs it only after reading the retained original request, configured input, result and current witness. CircuitTaskSourceReadbackV1 holds the same original Arc owner; it is not a cross-process decoder or transferable writer. Source Pending, missing, withdrawal or mismatched CURRENT cannot become a publication.
findings.implication: A child report cannot manufacture this opaque original-owner observation. Recovering a second live writer is not a substitute.

findings.finding: The private Source codec retains and decodes the complete original RunStartRecordV1, including original signature and objective bytes, from its anchored request frame. original_record is pub(super), not a public AgentdClient API.
findings.implication: Complete recorded bytes exist within original Source custody; no claim that the public daemon control response exports them.

findings.finding: AgentdClient::run_status returns AgentRunReceipt: run ID, revision, phase, context/compilation receipt, authority epoch, generation/fence/deadline, cancellation, terminal-observed and idempotent fields. It includes neither the Circuit history digest nor the full RunStart record. AgentdClient::run_start accepts lifecycle AgentRunSnapshot, not a signed ObjectiveStart or a task-result constructor.
findings.implication: Succeeded/terminal-observed or compilation_receipt_digest cannot stand in for the Circuit completed_task_receipt.

findings.finding: objective_admission matches the exact retained signed ingress and original claims against the original journal and optional retained anchor. Its public result is a historical publication projection with objective disposition and record/chain digests. It does not include full RunStart or task-result bytes. Historical reading intentionally does not apply current issuer expiry/revocation as a history-erasure rule.
findings.implication: This proves the scoped history observation, not current authorization, completed Circuit output, or independent task utility.

findings.finding: The original Learning Selection/NextUse read path operates on an Update publication and distinct successor task C, binding the prior learning cut and still-held original Source/Cell. It is not an A bootstrap publication exporter.
findings.implication: Do not relabel a C completion channel as an original A Source read.

findings.finding: CellQ24DatasetReaderV1::read_current_at_clock reads the original Source publication and compares agent, principal, cell, run, objective, original RunStart snapshot, completed_task_receipt against source.history_digest, and selected bundle. It reads the actual locked ledger, verifies the full signed freeze and exact source set, validates policy/terminal targets, rereads Source and ledger, checks fresh time, then reverifies the same freeze.
findings.implication: The original D path can close the proposed receipt binding only when its actual Source/current checks succeed; a report alone does not.

findings.finding: The original Material readback/source path requires existing completed E/D receipts. Fresh E/D must pass through original command roles. Experience Execute uses original attest_experience with actual Source/ledger. Dataset Execute first reads existing Experience, invokes original attest_dataset, and compares an immediate original Dataset readback. The original per-role admission bits, request bounds and bindings remain authoritative.
findings.implication: A failed first readback must not be silently upgraded to Execute. A prospective Pending Material type may enter only an explicitly authorized original E→D phase; T stays unavailable until the actual D checkpoint. This is a design condition, not an implemented or tested closure.

implementation_status: The new first-admission type/orchestrator is still being implemented and independently reviewed. This record supplies source facts and design constraints only.

proposed_first_admission_state_machine.admitted: Expose inputs usable for T only after actual original D validates the same fixed request and Source/current cut.
proposed_first_admission_state_machine.failure: Missing ownership, stale Source, absent result, bad signature, ambiguous effect or incomplete evidence remains Unknown/refusal; no fabricated NoUpdate or Fraud.
proposed_first_admission_state_machine.original_material: Only the existing authorized E→D commands may establish the first Material checkpoints; existing completed receipts may instead be read using original readonly interfaces.
proposed_first_admission_state_machine.pending: Verify bounded complete report, ledger replay, original Generator/Observer payload signatures and original freeze. Derived completion fields remain unverified against live Source. No SourcePublication or training authority may be constructed from those bytes.
proposed_first_admission_state_machine.preheld: Root owns the original full trust, allowed request/objective/cost/owners/rule/plan/signers and role/transport contract before receiving a report.

scope: Actual Git full source retrieval, exact local byte identities, and static review of the named constructor/readback/admission methods. This is not a full crate audit, build, test, gate, real A or runtime qualification.
